# Across all Modules

## Access

### GEN-01 — Roles and permissions

Statement: A Sales executive sees only their own Leads and Quotes; the sales head sees all. [CE-1]
Acceptance:
- A Sales executive cannot open another executive's Lead.
- The sales head sees every Lead and Quote.
Priority: Must
Scope: Neome
Sources: CE-1
OIs: —
Proposed: no

## Localisation

N/A: One currency (AED) and English only. [CE-1]

## Hosting

N/A: Neome cloud; no on-premise or SSO ask. [CE-1]

## Migration

### GEN-02 — Import open Leads

Statement: Open Leads from the old spreadsheet are imported before go-live.
Acceptance:
- Every open Lead in the spreadsheet shows in Neome with its owner.
Priority: Should
Scope: Neome
Sources: CE-1
OIs: —
Proposed: yes

## Training

N/A: The sales head trains the team in-house. [QA-1]

## Support

N/A: Standard Neome support only. [QA-1]
